publicTitle: Do the Safeguards Earn Their Cost?
question: Which safeguards actually change an operational result, and which merely add ceremony?
comparator: Bounded operational profile and component-level outcome/burden criteria; competent simpler-control architecture remains a future comparator.
procedure: evaluate each named safeguard under source-native operational criteria
retain positive negative and unevaluable outcomes separately
assess composed architecture without converting operational evidence into scientific support
environment: Repository-operational test surface; public reproduction may use a neutral reference implementation preserving the same semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Mixed component dispositions must be retained exactly; operational distinction must not be represented as scientific authority.
verifier: Independent bounded operational recomputation against the public method/result record.
proprietaryBoundary: The public target is the operational contract, component dispositions and acceptance criteria; complete private control-plane implementation is not required.
claimCeiling: One bounded repository-operation control profile only; no scientific authority, automatic product authority, cross-repository transfer, universal enforcement or simpler-baseline superiority.
